status: Four sensed row drivers for the wrist board; coupled-array and hardware checks pending
voltage_datum_note: Use a centered numerical reference for AC/DC macromodel solves. Reload the actual 0 V-ground circuit for transient startup and convert DC endpoints explicitly. This does not change physical supply or bias voltages.

amplifiers.location: Wrist board, after each row-selection switch

selection.logic: SEL=0 connects B to D; connect B to VBIAS and A to VEXCITE. Four 100 kohm select pull-downs keep all rows at bias during reset.
selection.enable_note: TMUX1134 has no global enable input. Do not apply the TMUX1133 enable pinout.

feedback.connection: Row current leaves through 47 ohms and the current conductor. The fanout distribution land returns through its own sense conductor and 4.7 kohms to the inverting input. The 100 pF and 100 Mohm paths connect amplifier output directly to the inverting input.
feedback.revision_note: Increase output isolation from 10 to 47 ohms after the first light-load AC cases missed the 45-degree screen. Reduce the sense resistor from 10 to 4.7 kohms to shorten the local-feedback time constant and reduce its DC sense-current drop.
feedback.limits: The weak local DC path introduces a small load-dependent sense error. A disconnected sense wire is not automatically qualified as detected.

monitor.location: From each amplifier output pin to a separate MCP3208 monitor input
monitor.limits: Monitor outputs are local amplifier voltages, not high-accuracy measurements of the remote row lands.

interconnect.limits: Placeholder interconnect resistance/capacitance, not the final routed cable/flex network.

screen.operating_point_note: Use the nominal external-node voltages only as released NODESET initial guesses, with Sparse 1.3; step DC sources from the verified baseline instead of solving an isolated loaded endpoint.
limits: One row at a time with ideal bias/reference sources. The complete four-row, sixteen-column network remains a separate check.
A 6.25 ohm load represents sixteen 100 ohm cells in parallel to stiff bias; actual inactive columns do not all have that termination.
Eight milliampere source/sink steps are electrical stresses, not a mapping from 20 N.
Typical amplifier model and lumped switches; charge injection, tolerances, temperature and layout remain to be qualified.
